title: NASA's Advanced Air Mobility Playbook: Emergency Response
description: NASA’s vision for Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) is to map out a safe, accessible, and affordable new air transportation system alongside industry partners and the FAA. AAM will aid in disaster response by adding more ways to safely rescue people, drop supplies to hard-to-reach areas and fight fires. In this episode of NASA's Advanced Air Mobility Playbook, NASA project manager Misty Davies explains the value and feasibility of this exciting public good use case.  To learn more, visit http://www.nasa.gov/aam
keywords: aam, advanced air mobility, uam, urban air mobility, national campaign, drone, ARMD, aeronautics, AAM Playbook, emergency response
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
